title: Challenging the Abilities of Large Language Models in Italian: a Community Initiative

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the recognition and generation of gender-fair language in monolingual rewriting and cross-lingual translation tasks, as well as detecting misogyny and pejorative epithets directed at women.
Analyzing the model's fact-checking accuracy across claims and statements associated with different political orientations to detect systematic deviations.
Assessing factual knowledge and reasoning using a dataset specifically grounded in Italian culture, conventions, and society to test for and avoid Anglo-centric ideological and topical biases.
Testing if incorporating annotator metadata, specifically age/generation and gender, into prompts alters the model's predictions in an irony detection task.
